documents.title: Robertson to Sprague: troop deployment publicity and exact timing
documents.author: Walter S. Robertson
documents.note: Footnote: DEF 933889 Dec 11 1957 says US unit deployment NOT contingent on ROK force reduction; Jan 16 Irwin letter says battalions deploying by Jan 31.

documents.title: Sprague to Robertson: proposed Matador missile group deployment
documents.author: Mansfield D. Sprague
documents.note: Plan for 588th Tactical Missile Group advance echelon in Q4 FY1958, full emplacement about 18 months later; not actual 1958-01 arrival.
